name: rating
title: Rating
description: Stars with half steps: hover previews the value, a click on the left half of a star picks .5, and the arrows, Home, End and digit keys change it. A read-only mode reads “4.6 · 2,184 reviews”, and a compact pill shows one star with the number for lists and tables.
